title: Source Profile
description: Vendor-neutral governance metadata about a data provider and its rights posture. No secrets, credentials, pricing, or private terms. See docs/SOURCE_GOVERNANCE.md.

provider_id.description: Governed LadybugBets identity of the provider.

access_basis.description: Basis of access, described in public-safe terms only.

terms_reference.description: Pointer to governing terms/evidence. Reference only, never the contents.

terms_checked_date.description: Date the terms posture was last reviewed.

attribution_requirements.description: Attribution the source requires when its data is shown.

rights_matrix.description: Each capability is tracked independently. Access does not imply retain/publish/redistribute.

qualification_status.description: Overall governed status. Real qualification belongs to Sprint 2.

posture.description: Controlled rights posture. UNKNOWN fails closed for publication.
